items: Remember the golden rule for time calculation: 'East Gain Add (EGA)' and 'West Lose Subtract (WLS)' relative to Greenwich.
The Standard Meridian of India (82°30' E) passes through 5 states: Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh.
Direct questions often ask to calculate local time of a city given its longitude relative to GMT or IST.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Earth rotates 360° on its axis in 24 hours, which calculates to 15° per hour or 1° every 4 minutes.
As the Earth rotates from West to East, places east of Greenwich are ahead of GMT, while places west of Greenwich are behind GMT.
Indian Standard Time (IST) is calculated from the standard meridian of 82°30' E longitude, passing through Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh.
IST is exactly 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT +5:30).
Crossing the International Date Line (180° Longitude) from West to East gains a day, while crossing from East to West loses a day.
